Shenmue I/II - @COMMIT@
-------------------------------------------

This release reimplements the original Shenmue I and Shenmue II games as ASI plugins for the Steam releases.


To install, copy shenmue1e.asi into your Shenmue I & II installation directory, inside the sm1 subdirectory, alongside Shenmue.exe.
Copy shenmue2e.asi into your Shenmue I & II installation directory, inside the sm2 subdirectory, alongside Shenmue2.exe.


Ultimate ASI Loader:
https://github.com/ThirteenAG/Ultimate-ASI-Loader/

If you do not already have an ASI loader, copy the included d3d11.dll into sm1 or sm2, alongside Shenmue.exe or Shenmue2.exe respectively.

Launch the original games through Steam.
